name: LOSTANARCHY • Java + Bedrock
description:
Welcome to LostAnarchy — a fresh Java and Bedrock crossplay anarchy server built around freedom, survival and permanent player history.

There are no land claims, no protected bases and no planned map resets. Players are free to raid, grief, steal, fight, trade, form teams and place bounties on their enemies.

Hacked clients are allowed with only a small number of restrictions. Creative Flight, NoFall, Speed, High Jump, Long Jump, LiquidWalk and modified Criticals are prohibited. Lag machines and crash exploits are also prohibited.

Features:

• Java and Bedrock crossplay

• No land claims

• No map resets

• Hacked clients allowed

• Vanilla farms and duplication mechanics allowed

• Player-created teams and private team chat

• Player bounties

• Chest shops and player-driven economy

• Proximity voice chat

• Randomized spawn area

• Homes and teleport requests

• Daily voting rewards

• Permanent survival world

There are no starter kits, no keep inventory and no admin protection from other players. Every base can be discovered, every item can be stolen and every alliance can be broken.

Join LostAnarchy and become part of the server’s history from the beginning.
